text:
ella: quick check  Priya is on J-1 with 212(e). counsel says a waiver or consular stamping may be required before she can work in the US. can people-ops clarify payroll, benefits, and relocation advance options?
priya: hi! im okay to start remotely from india for a couple months. worried about timing for relocation and signing bonus if the on-site start slips.
sam: short answer: payroll requires valid US work auth for I-9. benefits & 401k enrollment need an active employee record. relocation/signing payments usually run through payroll after hire_date, but we can consider an advance with finance approval.
marco: from counsel: waiver vs consular route affects timeline. waivers can take 3-9+ months; consular stamping adds variability. if Priya stays abroad and is paid by Redwood as a contractor/vendor, we must run local compliance checks.
ella: team can accept remote-limited ramp: meetings, docs, pairing ok. no prod access or write perms until payroll + background check clear.
priya: if company issues a relocation advance while i'm abroad, will US taxes be withheld? that could be a problem.
comp-finance: FYI: advances processed on payroll are taxable and subject to US withholding. If you're abroad, you may need to file for tax credits/refunds locally later. We can evaluate a gross-up (net-advance) to cover withholding, subject to approval.
sam: practical options:
- Option A: delay payroll until US start; relocation/signing paid on first payroll check (default)
- Option B: issue a taxable payroll advance now (subject to US withholding)
- Option C: process as vendor/contractor payment if Priya remains outside IN; requires contractor agreement + local tax checks
priya: Option B could leave me short due to withholding. how long to get gross-up approval?
comp-finance: typically 3-5 business days to review net-vs-gross requests; need manager sign-off and justification. finance may require a repay clause if employment doesn't start.
marco: legal note: contractor route can create permanent establishment / local withholding risk for Redwood in some jurisdictions. counsel must review country-specific guidance before pursuing C2.
sam: next steps we propose:
- Priya: confirm remote onboarding preference and whether you need a net advance estimate
- Priya: upload DS-2019 + passport photo page to secure portal (redact non-required PII)
- Counsel (Marco): confirm waiver intake status or consular options timeline in 5bd
- Comp/Finance: review gross-up net-advance request if Priya wants a net relocation advance
- People-ops: create "remote-limited" onboarding checklist and restrict prod access until cleared
ella: team OK with remote-limited ramp. please tag me on comp/finance replies.
priya: thanks all. i'll upload docs and request a net-advance estimate. appreciate the flexibility :pray:
payroll-bot: recorded provisional_state = "pending_work_auth". no payroll or benefits enrollments until I-9 clears.
